originalDetailedMeasurements.PROTECTED_FIELDS: Measured on the pixels over the WHOLE DOCUMENT, with a detector proven to fire in the same run. All 43 pages of both delivered fixtures were rendered at 300 dpi and differenced against their paired source pages: added ink inside any of the 210 declared refusal rectangles is 0 px, on every page of both fixtures, under both the rounded and the floor/ceil bracketing convention. The same code path, in the same runs, reads 147,515 px (canonical) and 324,397 px (boundary) of added ink inside declared WRITE rectangles, so this is a discriminated zero. No signature, signature date, judge, clerk or prosecutor field carries ink. protectedWrites 0. THE MIS-DECLARATION OF COURT-OWNED FIELDS IS REAL AND IS SCORED UNDER REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, not here: this obligation asks whether such a field carries ink, and none does.
originalDetailedMeasurements.CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP: Both halves measured over all 86 page comparisons, neither inferred. OVERLAP: added ink outside every declared write rectangle is 0 px on all 43 pages of both fixtures, so nothing the build drew landed on the form's own printing. No page carries ink on its outer 8-pixel frame. LOST INK: 0 px on 42 of the 43 pages of each fixture. THE ONE EXCEPTION IS NOT LOST PRINTING AND THIS LANE CHASED IT DOWN RATHER THAN REPORTING A SCARY NUMBER: delivered page 18 reads lost 36,935 px on BOTH fixtures. Localised, that ink is two solid uniform rectangles in the top-right corner, raster y 58-146 and x 2089-2520, with no glyph structure -- printed as an ASCII map, they are featureless blocks. They are the button faces of the kit's two interactive pushbuttons, formPrint at PDF rect x 501.336 y 756.622 49.836x21.378 and formSafeClear at x 555.324 y 756.622 49.835x21.378, which poppler paints when rendering the empty source with annotations and which no longer render once the AcroForm is re-saved. No printed form content is covered or erased anywhere in the packet. The identical 36,935 px appears on nj_arrest_no_conviction-set's delivered page 18 as well, which is the corroboration that it is a property of the form and not of this family. The lost-ink detector was proved to read an erasure to the pixel (4,838 px) before any lost = 0 was trusted.
originalDetailedMeasurements.PAGE_ORDER: Proved by pairing rather than asserted. Each of the 43 delivered pages was rendered at 300 dpi and differenced against the source page of the SAME number, on both fixtures -- 86 comparisons. Lost ink is 0 on 84 of them and, on the two page-18 comparisons, is entirely the two pushbutton faces identified under CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP. A page out of order would erase the whole of one printed page and add the whole of another; 86 comparisons with no such reading is the pairing proof. It also confirms the component page identities the delivery record claims: pages 18-19, 20-24, 27 and 30-33.
originalDetailedMeasurements.REPEATING_ROWS: No row carries written cells beside required cells left blank, and this is a pixel reading rather than an adoption. The item (d) conviction row is withheld whole -- page 19 carries 0 added ink on both fixtures. The petition arrest row and the Form C arrest table row 1 are likewise withheld whole: arrestOff1, origCaseNums, arrest1Dt and arrest1CaseNum all appear in heldButNotPrinted with reason withheld_for_row_integrity (arrest1CaseNum on the boundary for width instead), and none of their rectangles carries added ink. Across all 43 pages of both fixtures, the eight declared write fields that draw nothing are exactly the members of those withheld rows plus ExpungeCntyName; no row is half-drawn anywhere. incompleteRows 0, and the shared verifier agrees.
originalDetailedMeasurements.ROUTE_OPTIONS: THIS IS THE OBLIGATION VF11 FAILED AND FIX167 REPAIRED, AND THIS LANE PASSES IT ON THE EXPRESS PROPOSITION THAT THE OPTION IS NOT MISSING BUT UNELECTABLE FROM HELD FACTS -- SAID EXPLICITLY, AS THE GRANT REQUIRES. THE REFUSAL IS RIGHT ON THE MERITS AND THIS LANE DECIDED IT INDEPENDENTLY. (1) THE ARITHMETIC, RE-DERIVED: item (d) is a nine-cell sworn paragraph -- guiltyDt, guiltyOff1, guiltyStatute, guiltyFinal1, guiltyCrt, guiltyTimeType, guiltyDocCmpltDt, guiltyProbDt, guiltyFineDt. Exactly THREE carry a held fact (guiltyDt=matter.conviction_date, guiltyOff1=matter.charge, guiltyCrt=matter.court) and SIX have none. FIX167's 'six of nine' is exact. (2) THE ROW IS WITHHELD WHOLE, NOT PARTLY: reports/actual-writes.json records guilty, guiltyCrt, guiltyDt and guiltyOff1 all as heldButNotPrinted with reason withheld_for_row_integrity, on BOTH fixtures, so the paragraph prints nothing at all. (3) PROVED ON THE PIXELS: delivered page 19 differenced against source page 19 returns ADDED 0 and LOST 0 on both fixtures. Not one pixel is added anywhere on that page, so the 18x18 pt election box at x 34.971 y 591.363 is unmarked and no cell of the paragraph is printed. A marked box over a wholly blank sworn paragraph would be an assertion the packet cannot support, and it does not make one. (4) THE ROUTE-SPECIFIC REASON HOLDS TOO: item (d) prints 'in violation of N.J.S.A. (statute(s))', a state statute line a municipal ordinance conviction does not have, and the ordinance / disorderly-persons / Title 39 classification is a self-help stop this packet names. (5) THE RECORD NOW SAYS SOMETHING TRUE, which is what the repair was for: the row is decision refuse, blankTreatment REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, requiredBeforeFiling true, routeDetermined false, determinedByTheCaseNotTheRoute true, with a non-empty whyTheRouteCannotDetermineIt, and the election reaches the participant guide in the court's own printed words rather than as the bare terminal name. Before the repair the map declared the build MADE this election while no fixture marked it -- a false record, whatever one thinks of the withdrawal. (6) THE DETECTOR DISCRIMINATES, WHICH IS WHY THIS PASS MEANS SOMETHING: this lane's own detector, reading the field map against the finalizer's drawn selections, clears nj_arrest_no_conviction-set, nj_clean_slate-set and nj_ordinance-set and fires on nj_disorderly_persons-set and nj_indictable_conviction-set; and the builder's own guard, with its gate forced ON host-wide, exits 0 on the first two and 1 on the last two. requiredOptionsMissing 0, re-derived here and confirmed against the shared verifier, which reads 1 at base and 0 at HEAD.
